c-2575b050772df9b6.texto: In some parts of the East a seat is placed in the court-yard, where the master of the house may sit and give judgment on all domestic affairs. This seat is usually placed in some shady part of the court, against a wall or column. Thus in the text, Eli “sat upon a seat by a post.”…

h-88c568bdb80182b6.texto: Del nacimiento de Samuel a la muerte de Saúl. Sin introducción propia de JFB en el repositorio; Poole sí la tiene.
